input.summary: Cap the post-termination Competing Product restriction on Ono at 12 months and add carve-outs for internal development and acquired products.
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept an open-ended post-termination restriction on the products we may commercialize, so we have capped the tail at twelve (12) months and carved out our internal research/development and products acquired via M&A. We are comfortable leaving the mutual in-term exclusivity in Section 8.2 as drafted.

ops.oldText: prior to the [ * ] anniversary of the date such termination takes effect.
ops.newText: for a period of twelve (12) months following the date such termination takes effect; provided that such restriction shall not apply to (i) any internal research or Development activities of Ono or its Affiliates, or (ii) any product Controlled by a Third Party that is acquired by Ono or any of its Affiliates by means of a merger, acquisition or similar transaction.
